title: From protocol state to allocation
html:
MAINNET
USDC × 3 venues
→
ORACLES 1 / 2 / 3
separate wallets
→
DEVNET FEEDS
median · quorum 3
→
CONSUMER
integer rubric
→
ALLOCATION STATE
10000 bps

All three oracles independently read all three protocols. Each signs one vote per venue and devnet slot window. The consumer reads finalized feed heads from chain.

240-slot sample windows. One consumer ⇒ allocation quorum 1. Agreement is proven; source independence and consumer decentralization are outside this demo.
notes: Implements specs/SPECIFICATION.md: producer → series consensus → ring buffer → consumer → allocation consensus → AllocationState.

Static neutral risk discount (0 bps) and 50% per-venue caps are an explicit demo policy.
Base supply interest APY excludes token incentive emissions.
The single consumer uses the devnet registry admin to open rounds; producer containers only receive their own key.
Samples attest agreement by three operators using the same public mainnet RPC; this is not source decentralization.
Latest feed reads have an RPC context lower bound; historical input commitments are not implemented.
